name: notes-long-chat
description: Fourteen short questions in one chat about five notes: longer than the 19 messages Chat sends, so the history's window moves. The answers stay right, and — on a hybrid local model — a turn re-reads only its own message most of the time (the window moves three turns at a time, chats::history_start; prompt tokens processed per call in transcript.jsonl).

notes.title: Kitchen quotes
notes.content:
Harlow Kitchens: £14,200 including fitting, quartz worktops, eight weeks lead time.
Local joiner: £11,800, laminate worktops, appliances not fitted.
Deposit 25% on signing.

notes.title: Car service
notes.content:
Golf due its 60,000-mile service: £340 plus £95 for front brake pads.
MOT runs out on 3 January: book both together in December.
Insurance renews 19 November, last year £612.

notes.title: Running plan
notes.content:
Week 6: Tuesday 8 km easy, Thursday 6 x 800 m intervals, Saturday long run 16 km.
Race in Cardiff on 7 December, target under 1:55.

notes.title: Team retro
notes.content:
Went well: release checklist, faster code review.
Didn't: flaky end-to-end tests, unclear owner of the support inbox.
Actions: Priya quarantines the flaky tests, Dave drafts a support rota.

notes.title: Book club
notes.content: Next book: The Remains of the Day. Meeting at Sarah's on the 28th at 7:30. Sarah is vegetarian; bring snacks.
